name: Successive left turns around a set of obstacles
expected: Tick 3: (4,1) ahead at (4,2): Turn Left. Tick 6: Forward heading W.
Tick 7: (2,2) ahead at (3,2): Turn Left again. Tick 10: Forward heading S.
Tick 13: (3,6) ahead at (3,5): Turn Left. Tick 16: Forward heading E.
Tick 22: wall ahead at (9,5): Turn Left.
Every turn lasts 3 ticks with clean_off and is followed by Forward + clean_on.
function_text: EF-03 – Front obstacle detection by interrupt (walls and obstacles); false only updates the store
EF-06 – Avoidance: turn left, left has priority when both sides are free
EF-08 – 3-tick turn, then resume forward with clean_on
EF-09 – Cleaning stopped (clean_off) only while turning or reversing
EF-17 – Direction and Clean are sent only when their value changes; signals only on transitions
